reason: H0 cannot select WUFFS_BASE__PIXEL_FORMAT__Y_16LE as either src_pixfmt or dst_pixfmt because both are chosen exclusively from pixfmts, which contains WUFFS_BASE__PIXEL_FORMAT__Y_16BE but not WUFFS_BASE__PIXEL_FORMAT__Y_16LE. Consequently, the new Y_16LE source dispatch in wuffs_base__pixel_swizzler__prepare and all conversion functions returned by wuffs_private_impl__pixel_swizzler__prepare__y_16le are unreachable from fuzz_swizzle_interleaved_from_slice. This is material because the added routines perform unchecked-width reads and writes across 1-, 2-, 3-, 4-, and 8-byte destination representations, while the harness is specifically designed to detect boundary violations with guarded pages and randomized slice lengths.
evidence: H0 declares pixfmts with WUFFS_BASE__PIXEL_FORMAT__Y and WUFFS_BASE__PIXEL_FORMAT__Y_16BE, but no WUFFS_BASE__PIXEL_FORMAT__Y_16LE.
fuzz_swizzle_interleaved_from_slice constructs both dst_pixfmt and src_pixfmt only as pixfmts[... % num_pixfmts].
S1 adds case WUFFS_BASE__PIXEL_FORMAT__Y_16LE in wuffs_base__pixel_swizzler__prepare, dispatching to wuffs_private_impl__pixel_swizzler__prepare__y_16le.
wuffs_private_impl__pixel_swizzler__prepare__y_16le selects new conversion implementations for destinations including Y, BGR_565, BGR/RGB, 4-byte formats, and 4X16LE formats.
The new implementations directly use s[1], wuffs_base__peek_u16le__no_bounds_check, and no-bounds-check destination pokes, making varied short and odd-length guarded slices fuzz-worthy.
recommended_action: Add WUFFS_BASE__PIXEL_FORMAT__Y_16LE to H0's pixfmts selection set so it can be independently chosen as src_pixfmt and dst_pixfmt; retain randomized odd, short, and boundary-positioned src_len and dst_len values to exercise every destination branch of wuffs_private_impl__pixel_swizzler__prepare__y_16le.
